ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white central region; solid black banding along the leading edges and distal tips; V-shaped black pigmentation at the median notch vertex; scattered dark focal spots localized near the peduncle insertion.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 85 degrees and a bounding-box depth roughly 12% of the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the continuous trailing edge; significant jagged irregularity and tattering at both terminal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward and outward sweep; outer trailing edges exhibit a convex curve transitioning to concavity toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark circular pixel clusters observed on the lower lobes near the water line and within the black pigmentation of the distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark diagonal linear disruptions on the right lobe; sparse horizontal linear markings on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced jagged erosion and physical trauma marks on the distal right fluke tip; prominent dark vertical streak extending from the median notch base.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark anchor-shaped pigmentation pattern at the vertex of the median notch extending towards the peduncle.
